Formula: (Completed Trainees ÷ Total Trainees) × 100 = Completion Rate%

2. Employment Rate (After 6 Months)

Formula: (Employed Trainees ÷ Total Trained) × 100 = Employment Rate%
Example: (100 Employed ÷ 200 Trained) × 100 = 50% Employment

3. Employment to Completion Ratio

Formula: (Employed Trainees ÷ Completed Trainees) × 100 = Ratio%
Example: (100 Employed ÷ 120 Completed) × 100 = 83.33% Ratio

4. Year-over-Year Growth Rate

Formula: ((Current Year - Previous Year) ÷ Previous Year) × 100 = Growth%
